subject.title: Codex dynamic tools should normalize raw plugin payloads

question: Which open raw-payload normalization path should become the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: Both linked PRs target the same current-main bug, and automation should not queue a third fix while maintainers still need to consolidate the branch, proof, and serialization shape.

options.title: Consolidate on one existing candidate
options.body: Pick one linked PR, require accessible real behavior proof plus focused regression coverage, and close the other after the chosen fix lands.

options.title: Open a maintainer replacement
options.body: Use a new narrow replacement only if both contributor branches are too conflicted or too risky to repair cleanly.

options.title: Leave both candidates pending
options.body: Keep this issue open without a selected landing path, accepting duplicate review churn until a maintainer decides.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on one existing candidate
recommendation.body: Pick one linked PR, require accessible real behavior proof plus focused regression coverage, and close the other after the chosen fix lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history on the Codex dynamic-tool bridge and middleware result path.
